item.title: Version 0.11.0
item.description:
0.11.0

  • New reminder style "At a pause": waits until you stop typing for a moment, then appears at the cursor, so it never cuts into a sentence.
  • New onboarding steps: choose the apps where TalkRemind stays quiet (your most used apps first), see how reminders are timed in an interactive diagram, and try it in a practice field with your real reminder.
  • Settings › Sensitivity: every timing rule is adjustable — words before a reminder, the pause that starts a new writing block, the gap between reminders, limits per hour and per day, and quiet time after dictating.
  • Reminders show TalkRemind's icon plus your dictation app and its shortcut. Pick your dictation app and record any shortcut in Settings, including remapped ones (e.g. Karabiner-Elements).
  • No more reminders while you type in TalkRemind's own windows, and a stability fix in keystroke handling.
